items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I noticed you put your ligature on the way Veneta told me to do it.

ctx.x: award for playing. I just thought we had to plan that we wanted to refer to something like a certain key or a certain thing in a couple minutes ago last year. I'm not going to keep you wrong, but I don't think we'll actually be done. Is that a new read? Yeah, give it to you. It's pretty stiff. Well, that's the stiffest I've got. This is all right. It's not a stiff one. Remember the time you went out to play with Kid Thomas and all they had was a soft read on Edmund and the Washington's. I'm not sure. And that…
I noticed you put your ligature on the way Veneta told me to do it. Apparently some people put the screws on the other side.
Well, the reason I put mine on there is because usually when you get ready to put that cap on there, and if you're not using it, you'll mess your ears.
